h1: B2B Lead Generation Agency in Kolkata
intro: Kolkata carries decades of strength in trading, steel, and engineering, alongside a fast-growing IT sector. We build the AI-powered cold email, LinkedIn, and ABM systems that turn that legacy into new pipeline.

why.title: Decades of trading relationships, no way to grow past them
why.desc: Kolkata's legacy trading houses, and its long-standing strength in jute, steel, and engineering, have grown on networks built over generations. That's a strong foundation, but it caps growth once every existing relationship has been tapped.

why.title: An IT sector competing against better-funded rivals
why.desc: Kolkata's growing IT and ITES companies are up against far larger tech hubs like Bengaluru and Pune for the same buyers. Winning that fight needs a sharper, more systematic outbound motion, not more cold calls.

why.title: Financial services with deep history, thin digital pipeline
why.desc: The city's long-established financial services base has real credibility, but much of its new-business generation still depends on personal networks rather than a repeatable outbound system.

healthcareTitle: Healthcare lead generation in Kolkata, for B2B sellers
healthcareIntro: Kolkata is the main healthcare hub for eastern India, and the companies that supply its hospitals, diagnostic chains and distributors sell to a small set of hard-to-reach decision-makers. If you sell medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare software or pharma products, we build outreach that reaches the people who actually buy:
healthcareBuyers: Procurement heads and purchase committees at hospital groups
Lab and operations heads at diagnostic chains
Pharma and medical-device distributors across eastern India
Hospital administrators and IT heads evaluating healthcare software
healthcareNote: This is B2B outreach to buyers inside healthcare organisations, not patient acquisition for hospitals or clinics. See how it works for [pharma and healthcare companies](/lp/pharma), or read the [dermatology pharma case study from India](/case-studies/pharma-india-dermatologist-outreach) and the [medical tourism platform case study](/case-studies/medical-tourism-platform-pipeline).
